in_marathi.name: Kalipada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalipada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kalipada is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Kali' meaning black and 'pada' meaning foot. The name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as having black skin and is referred to as Kali. Thus, Kalipada can be interpreted as the 'Black-footed God'.
